description: Uncertainty in Renewable and Flexible Generation - Stochastic Adequacy Assessment of Future Energy Systems (ULYSSES) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by House of Energy; Climate and Finance (HECF) at University of Duisburg-Essen (UDE). ULYSSES is an open-source tool for quantifying and simulating uncertain factors of the power system, such as electricity demand, power generated by renewable energy sources, and availability of thermal generation capacities. Coverage: Germany, United Kingdom, Ukraine. Methodical focus: Resource Adequacy, Uncertainty Characterization. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
